finding.expected: Reuse the existing canonical Runtime validators or strictly shared deterministic helpers so every canonical/local terminal is proven sufficiently valid before it may drive lifecycle continuation. RESULT must establish exact RESULT/EVIDENCE/RUN/subject and required-verification binding as applicable; FAILURE must establish exact RUN/TASK/base/failed-head/candidate binding needed by current repair semantics. Malformed evidence, subject/RUN mismatch, or malformed failure binding must reduce to bounded BLOCKED/NONE. Add focused regressions for both canonical and local malformed terminal cases while preserving all exact correction-lineage behavior already fixed.
finding.issue: RUN-086-004 fixes F5: DELTA predecessor resolution now follows exact immutable correction continuity through REMEDIATION and REPAIR, including a REPAIR of a failed REMEDIATION, without restoring TASK-wide finding-id search. However the separate terminal-contract defect first recorded as REVIEW-086-001 F3 remains unresolved on this current candidate. Canonical and local RESULT terminals are still accepted after validating only the nested RESULT object and head SHA, without proving the ResultPackage EVIDENCE binding or required verification contract before the reducer can emit SEMANTIC_REVIEW or RETRY_TRANSPORT. Local FAILURE validation likewise remains materially narrower than the canonical Runtime FAILURE/RUN/candidate binding. A malformed terminal can therefore still drive an actionable next_action instead of reducing fail-closed as malformed state.
